cases.title: A brief missed object frame followed by a stream outage
cases.expectation: One missed frame and an unavailable stream must not manufacture an object disappearance or placement; the returning object remains one encounter.

cases.title: Two visible people and mixed speech with no known speaker
cases.expectation: Even with an injected useful-memory decision, mixed speech must not be assigned to an arbitrary visible person.

events.text: I live in Toronto. No, I live in Waterloo.

cases.title: One weak face observation during a head turn
cases.expectation: A confirmed identity survives one weak observation and recovers without a new encounter.

checks.name: Name coasts across a weak frame

cases.title: Another person occupies the same face box
cases.expectation: Conflicting positive identity evidence clears the previous name before confirming the replacement.

cases.title: Several weak observations expire identity
cases.expectation: Coasting is bounded; three weak observations do not retain a name indefinitely.

cases.title: A partial preference is negated in the final transcript
cases.expectation: Partials never persist, the corrected final is saved verbatim once, and duplicate delivery creates no extra note.

checks.name: Visible person is not asserted to be speaker

cases.title: A delayed final arrives after the conversation partner changes
cases.expectation: Speech captured with Bob must not become Alice's memory when the transcript arrives later; abstaining is acceptable.
cases.known_gap: The current app binds at final receipt and ignores the utterance's historical face context.

events.text: I'm going to the park tomorrow.

checks.name: No wrong-person memory after delayed final

cases.title: An implied need should reach the general agent
cases.expectation: After an injected positive trigger, 'I need to ask Bob about his trip' should initiate useful work without a fixed reminder-command prefix.
cases.known_gap: The current app still requires its supported command grammar and has no general-purpose agent handoff.

events.text: I need to ask Bob about his trip.

checks.name: Positive trigger produces an action or handoff

cases.title: Three useful finals arrive while a decision is in flight
cases.expectation: All accepted finalized statements must be processed; newest-frame-wins must not silently discard useful speech.
cases.known_gap: The bridge has one replaceable pending slot, so the middle final is reported dropped and never evaluated.

events.text: I'm moving to Montreal next month.
